title: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.07122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. translated_title: 基于固定与自适应惩罚的按需自动驾驶出行运营商监管：一种多智能体强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 以利润最大化为目标的按需自动驾驶出行运营商可能通过过高定价剥削消费者剩余，并将车辆从盈利较低的区域调离，导致这些区域服务不足。本文研究在多模式出行系统中，如何通过基于惩罚的监管手段限制运营商的动态加价行为并改善区域服务可用性。我们将监管建模为作用于基于学习的运营商的外部控制回路：采用固定惩罚的静态监管被表述为一个马尔可夫决策过程，由运营商联合控制定价与车辆再平衡；动态监管则被表述为一个部分可观测随机博弈，其中监管者以闭环方式周期性调整针对不同区域的惩罚。运营商与监管者的策略均通过基于图的多智能体强化学习进行训练。在基于纽约曼哈顿真实数据的实验中，固定的动态加价惩罚降低了面临过高价格的出行者比例……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于图的多智能体强化学习监管框架，通过固定或闭环自适应调整的区域惩罚机制，约束按需自动驾驶出行运营商的过高定价与车辆再平衡行为，从而抑制动态加价并改善区域服务公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning framework in which a regulator uses fixed or closed-loop adaptive region-specific penalties to constrain an AMoD operator's pricing and rebalancing, curbing surge pricing and improving regional service equity.
